blurb: At the Upstate Pinball & Arcade Museum, we offer a fun experience for all ages. Whether you come to experience the nostalgia of the late 20th Century or to find out what exactly there is to love about colored blocks moving across a screen, our diverse collection of pinball machines and video arcade games can guarantee a good time.
